sources.entry: Davis - A simple, dockerizable and fully translatable admin interface for sabre/dav based on Symfony 5 and Bootstrap 4, largely inspired by Baïkal. MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Davis is a dockerizable, translatable CalDAV/CardDAV/WebDAV server with a web admin dashboard, built on sabre/dav and Symfony 7.
use_cases: Sync calendars and contacts between phones, desktops and other clients
Share calendars with other users or via public links
Manage DAV users, calendars and address books from a web dashboard
Generate automatic birthday calendars from contact birthdates
Host a self-hosted CalDAV/CardDAV server behind a reverse proxy
Authenticate DAV users against IMAP or LDAP directories
notable: Automatic birthday calendar updated when contact birthdates change
Supports Basic, IMAP and LDAP authentication methods
Ships Docker images in standard and standalone (with Caddy) flavours
Includes an app key system so services can act on a user's calendars without their password
Diagnostics page in the dashboard for checking configuration
caveats: Changing AUTH_REALM on an existing installation breaks legacy password hashes
IMAP and LDAP extensions are not enabled by default outside the Docker image
PostgreSQL and SQLite are described as not extensively tested
App keys are off by default and must be enabled with APP_KEYS_ENABLED=true
Older release branches (v3.x unmaintained, v4.x security fixes only)
